you can build a complete GTA 6 clipping studio with this 20 open-source repos and an AI coding agent.

from capturing livestreams to finding viral moments, reframing gameplay, adding captions, and exporting videos for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

here are the 20 tools behind the workflow:

CAPTURE AND SOURCE VIDEOS

01. Remotion Skills : gives coding agents instructions for building and rendering videos.

https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills

02. ClipsAI : automatically turns long videos into shorter, shareable clips.

https://github.com/ClipsAI/clipsai

03. FunClip : selects video segments using speech recognition and transcript-based editing.

https://github.com/modelscope/FunClip

04. yt-dlp : downloads videos from supported websites when you have permission to use them.

https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp

05. TwitchDownloader : downloads Twitch VODs, clips, and chat replays.

https://github.com/lay295/TwitchDownloader

06. Streamlink : captures livestreams from supported streaming platforms.

https://github.com/streamlink/streamlink

07. OBS Studio : records gameplay, reactions, and screen footage.

https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio

FIND THE BEST MOMENTS

08. PySceneDetect : detects scene changes to help identify different moments in a video.

https://github.com/Breakthrough/PySceneDetect

09. Auto-Editor : automatically removes silence and dead air.

https://github.com/WyattBlue/auto-editor

10. faster-whisper : transcribes speech locally with optimized Whisper models.

https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper

11. WhisperX : generates accurate word-level timestamps for subtitles.

https://github.com/m-bain/whisperX

12. Silero VAD : detects speech segments and separates them from silence.

https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad

REFRAME AND TRACK GAMEPLAY

13. MediaPipe : tracks faces, poses, and landmarks for smarter video framing.

https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe

14. OpenCV : provides computer vision tools for object tracking, cropping, and video processing.

https://github.com/opencv/opencv

CAPTIONS AND FINAL EDITING

15. Subtitle Edit : create, synchronize, correct, and style subtitles.

https://github.com/SubtitleEdit/subtitleedit

16. LosslessCut : trim video and audio without unnecessary re-encoding.

https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut

17. MoviePy : automate video editing with Python scripts.

https://github.com/Zulko/moviepy

18. OpenCut : open-source video editor for editing clips on a timeline.

https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut

19. Remotion : build reusable video templates and generate clips programmatically.

https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion

20. FFmpeg : handle video cropping, audio mixing, encoding, and final exports.

https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg

THE COMPLETE WORKFLOW:

1. capture gameplay or authorized livestream footage.
2. transcribe the video and detect interesting moments.
3. identify funny reactions, intense gameplay, and memorable scenes.
4. cut the best moments into short clips.
5. reframe everything into vertical 9:16.
6. add synchronized captions and audio.
7. export versions for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

you can use Claude Code or another coding agent to connect these tools into one automated workflow.

the goal is to spend less time editing and more time finding moments people actually want to watch.

capture → detect → clip → reframe → caption → export.

bookmark this list before building your GTA 6 content studio. ↓

Claude Fable 5.2 + TradingView... just took full control of the chart & it's f*cking DANGEROUS...

this FREE indicator scores every closed candle for AI agents, & this MCP bridge plugs Claude Code straight into TradingView, so Fable 5.2 reads the signal panel LIVE & calls SHORT, LONG or WAIT on its own

i rebuilt the setup as a paper desk & replayed every 4h candle of BTC, ETH & SOL from Nov 1 to Nov 17: Fable took 7 trades, said WAIT 6 times & all 6 closed trades ended green (+9.01R)

first understand how this setup works:

> you see candles, an AI agent can't read a chart
> the indicator scores every closed candle out of 100 for long & short & puts the signal, entry, stop & targets in a panel on your chart
> the bridge connects Claude Code to TradingView Desktop on your machine, so Fable 5.2 reads that panel, switches symbols & replays history by itself

how to use it with Fable 5.2:

1. paste ai-agent-lens.pine from the indicator repo into the Pine Editor on TradingView & hit "add to chart"

2. every closed candle gets a long & a short score out of 100, built from 5 factors, with no repainting

3. each setup comes with an entry, an ATR stop & 1.5R / 3R targets, drawn on your chart like TradingView's position tool

4. paste the install prompt from tradingview-mcp's README into Claude Code: it clones the repo, runs npm install & adds the MCP server for you

5. launch TradingView Desktop in debug mode with ONE command, the repo has the script for Mac, Windows & Linux

6. ask Claude to run tv_health_check & once it says connected, Fable 5.2 sees your chart

7. give Fable 5.2 agent/AGENT_PROMPT.md from the indicator repo & ask for the signal: decision, entry, stop, targets, size & exactly why it could fail

8. run tv stream tables & the indicator's panel streams into your terminal as JSON every time it changes

9. put it on ANY date with tv replay start & let Fable trade the chart bar by bar
